Elite Austin AC & Plumbing is a locally owned and operated HVAC and plumbing company based in Austin, Texas, serving residential and commercial customers throughout the Central Texas area. The company specializes in air conditioning, heating, indoor air quality, and plumbing services, offering repair, installation, maintenance, and construction support. Elite Austin AC & Plumbing is led by co-founders Kyle Bacon and Chris Shaffer, who bring complementary experience in HVAC technical leadership and business operations.

Leadership: Kyle Bacon — Co-Founder & Managing Member & Chris Shaffer — Co-Founder & Managing Member

Ownership: Locally owned & operated

Kyle Bacon — Co-Founder & Managing Member Kyle Bacon is originally from Cleveland, Ohio, where he began his career in the air conditioning business after earning a Bachelor’s degree in Business Management from Wittenberg University. He started in air conditioning replacement and construction sales in the Cleveland area and transferred to Austin when the market shifted. In Austin, Kyle has extensive experience working with custom home builders, providing air conditioning design consulting, product expertise, sales, system load calculations, quality control oversight, and project management for residential and custom builds. (Elite AC & Plumbing)

Chris Shaffer — Co-Founder & Member Chris Shaffer holds a Bachelor’s degree in Business from the University of Texas at Arlington. Before co-founding Elite Austin AC & Plumbing, Chris built a long track record of running and growing successful businesses in the home building industry. His experience includes managing operations, understanding new construction processes, and overseeing customer experiences post-construction. Chris brings his passion for quality service, operational leadership, and client satisfaction to the company’s HVAC and plumbing business model. (Elite AC & Plumbing)
